pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacco Drying Rack$() turns raw leaf into cured leaf. A rack holds up to $(item)16$() identical raw leaves. Leaves in one rack must be the same item with the same components/quality data.

pages.title: Tobacco Drying Rack
pages.text: Craft the rack before choosing a curing environment.

Right-click the rack with raw tobacco to add one leaf. Empty-hand right-click removes the batch. Sneak-right-click reports the rack status. Once curing reaches $(item)10%$(), the batch locks and no more leaves may be added until it is removed or finished.
pages.title: Loading the Rack

pages.text: The rack automatically chooses the strongest valid method each tick in this order: $(thing)Fire → Flue → Sun → Air$(). You do not select a mode in a menu; the structure and environment select it for you. With Create installed, fan airflow reaching either the lower or upper section can assist a valid cure.
pages.title: Automatic Method
Traditional Alternative
pages.text: A Drying Rack is not required. Sneak-right-click the underside of a sturdy block while holding 16 matching raw leaves to make a traditional hanging bunch. It cures by the same methods but cannot use hoppers or Display Links.
Hoppers can automate racks. Insert raw leaves from a horizontal side. The top and bottom cannot insert. A hopper underneath can extract only after curing is complete.
